1.note: Architecture approved incl. override of frozen single-FET spec to 2x EPC2019 parallel; unipolar 0/+5V drive; controlled-Z relaxed; outline 100x80 with pre-auth growth to 120x80

2.note: Schematic approved (erc 0/0, netlist_audit exit 0, 10/10 review findings fixed). Continue P5-P9 to fab-ready; P10 ordering held pending EPC2019 restock

3.note: Placement approved. SMA vertical top-mount (not edge-launch) accepted by owner - it is the only true-SMD 50R SMA at LCSC with no bottom-side joints, which the flat heatsink face requires

4.note: Owner approved all 8 waiver classes; owner chose: fix the four board-level thermal defects AND derate to 36V/~162W. Re-confirms schematic approval after the 3 post-H2 human_hold edits

decisions.what: Thermal: continuous 200 W duty, bottom-side heatsink pad + thermal via array under EPC2019, forced air assumed; single-sided (top) assembly so bottom is a heatsink mounting face
decisions.why: Owner answer at P0 batch. 35-50 W loss with output inductor ~7 W hotter than the GaN; worst-case design chosen

decisions.what: SAFETY ACK: no VSWR/OCP/OVP/thermal protection; matched or dummy 50 ohm load ONLY. Open/short output at 200 W will likely destroy the FET
decisions.why: Owner explicitly acknowledged. Class E loses ZVS under load pull; drain exceeds the 142.5 V design peak. Protection stays out of scope per power-stage-only brief

decisions.what: RF output connector = SMA (edge/PCB mount, 50 ohm, LCSC-stocked)
decisions.why: 200 W into 50 ohm at 20 MHz = 100 Vrms / 2 Arms, within SMA HF limits. N-type would break the 100% JLC PCBA rule

decisions.what: Drive input: 50 ohm termination direct to LMG1020 input, NO buffer stage
decisions.why: Owner gen supplies ~5 Vpp into 50 ohm with adjustable duty. Closes brief MUST-RESOLVE #4; fewest parts and lowest added delay

decisions.what: Defaults taken (owner did not specify): qty 5; no hard cost ceiling; outline ~100x80 mm SOFT (no hard cap); 4x M3 corner holes; 40 V bus via 2-pos screw terminal >=10 A; ambient 25 C bench w/ margin to 40 C; 5 V rail from onboard buck off the 40 V bus
decisions.why: Routine judgement calls. Outline deliberately left SOFT so the PCB air-core spiral inductor fallback stays available for the 6.6 A rms tank

decisions.what: CORRECTED EPC2019 specs from datasheet: Coss(er) 156 pF (not 110), package 2.77x0.95mm solder bars (not 1.35mm LGA), Rds(on) 22 typ/42 max (not 36), Qg 2.4/2.9 nC
decisions.why: Brief figures came from a web summary, not the datasheet. Two P1 agents independently verified. External C_shunt drops to ~161 pF

decisions.what: L_s and L_m to be etched as PCB air-core spirals, NOT catalog inductors
decisions.why: No LCSC part closes it: power inductors give Q 20-40 at 20 MHz (25-50 W); RF inductors rated 120-140 mA vs 6.6 A needed. Paralleling does NOT reduce loss (Q_total = Q_each). Spiral gives Q~130-150 at zero BOM cost

decisions.what: Two-zone floorplan mandatory: heatsink zone (Q1/L1/bulk/driver) vs magnetics zone (L_s/L_m/tank caps) with L2 plane keepout under spirals only
decisions.why: A metal heatsink or solid ground plane under a PCB spiral is a shorted turn. L2 stays unbroken under the power loop; cut out ONLY under spirals

decisions.what: TWO EPC2019 in parallel (overrides the frozen single-FET brief)
decisions.why: H1 owner approval. Only config where thermal closes: Tj 103 C vs 138 C. 2x Coss(er)=312 pF meets the 317 pF shunt need, deleting the external cap. 2-FET layout can build with one populated; reverse is impossible

decisions.what: Drive input is unipolar 0/+5V (generator TTL/CMOS mode); DC-coupled, no level shift, no AC coupling
decisions.why: H1 owner answer. LMG1020 input abs max -0.3 V forbids bipolar swing; AC coupling would destroy duty-cycle control that Class E depends on

decisions.what: Controlled-impedance 50 ohm output trace RELAXED to a wide low-loss pour
decisions.why: H1 owner approval. At 20 MHz a 15 mm run is lambda/550, perturbs load <2%; the controlled-Z 0.4332 mm geometry would run 50-75 C at 2 A rms

decisions.what: Outline 100x80 mm, P6 PRE-AUTHORISED to grow to 120x80 if a spiral cannot reach area. No hard --outline cap at P5
decisions.why: H1 owner approval. Spiral Q drives the dominant 16 W magnetics loss; ~+$3-6/board is worth protecting it

decisions.what: EPC2019 (C2836675) is OUT OF STOCK at LCSC (stock=0, price up 2.17->3.93). Design CONTINUES; order held pending restock. Re-verify at P10
decisions.why: Verified twice independently. No in-stock GaN substitute exists: 650V parts have Coss 239-760pF and 110-600mohm (8-11W conduction); EPC2051/2036 are 100-120V forcing a 25-33V bus. Stock-out does not change footprint/pinout/schematic, and it was in stock this morning, so design work is not wasted

decisions.what: LMG1020YFFR primary = Tokmas C6423790; alternate = genuine TI-branded C506817 (in stock)
decisions.why: Part-sourcer found a real TI listing, resolving the architecture's authenticity flag

decisions.what: RF choke L201 = 2x FXL0630-R47-M (470nH, 4.1mohm, 20A) in SERIES
decisions.why: No single LCSC part meets L/SRF/DCR/Isat together (SRF is essentially never published for adequately-rated parts). Uses the architecture's pre-authorised escape

decisions.what: AMENDED operating point (Sokal finite Q_L=5 coefficients): R_opt 4.13 ohm, C_shunt 403 pF, L_s 164 nH, C_s 518 pF, L_m 110 nH, C_m 530 pF, I_tank 6.96 A rms. Bus STAYS 40 V
decisions.why: Frozen brief used 1/(wR*5.4466), which is Sokal's Q_L->infinity constant, but the board runs Q_L=5. Loss 38.6 W / 83.8%, inside the frozen band

decisions.what: External shunt trim cap POPULATED at 3x33 pF (~87 pF), not DNP
decisions.why: EPC2019 Coss spreads 110-150 pF (+36%). If device Coss is the whole shunt, that spread lands on ZVS with no absorber. The external cap is the only trim element

decisions.what: TWO EPC2019 now MANDATORY (not merely preferred): single FET reaches Tj 160 C with a hypothetical 0 C/W heatsink, above the 150 C abs max
decisions.why: Real Rds(on) 36/50 mohm (65/90 hot). Pair gives 114 C nominal / 133 C max-corner at theta_HS <= 0.7 C/W. Dissipation is flat N=1->2; the win is RthJB halving per die

decisions.what: SMA re-sourced to C22418168 CONSMA001-SMD-G-T (TE/Linx), verified TRUE SMD from manufacturer drawing; 100% SMT preserved. Cost 0.39 -> 2.97 each
decisions.why: Previous BWSMA-KE-P001 was a THT vertical panel jack despite an SMD label. LCSC package/type fields are unreliable for mount style; verified via pad-layer inspection + customer drawing

decisions.what: EPC2019 footprint: end columns are 0.45 mm c-c (corrected 0.46 -> 0.450). The 0.68-0.70 mm figure is the OUTER ENVELOPE and was NOT applied
decisions.why: Fixer extracted datasheet vector geometry and refuted the librarian report. Applying 0.68 would have shifted the GATE pad 0.11 mm off a 0.25 mm pad

decisions.what: Board 120x80 mm, 4-layer JLC04161H-1080B, 1oz outer, 4x M3 corner holes. rules_gen: 23 rules, netclasses Pwr_5p5mm/Pwr_8p4123mm/Pwr_11p8942mm, HV clearances per net (TANK_A 180V)
decisions.why: Owner pre-authorised growth to 120x80; L301 courtyard fit at 100x80 was 0.01 mm, not a real margin. /SW needs 11.89 mm and +40V 5.5 mm track width at 200 W

decisions.what: Added explicit Description field to L301/L302 in tank.py to match the spiral footprints' descr
decisions.why: Stock Device:L Description is 'Inductor', which mismatched the custom footprint descr and failed board_init schematic parity (2 -> 0)

decisions.what: SMA jacks are vertical top-mount; cables exit upward. Owner accepted at H3
decisions.why: Only genuinely surface-mount 50R SMA at LCSC without B.Cu lands. Edge-launch would need THT + a heatsink notch or an off-catalog part

decisions.what: 12 intra-EPC2019 clearance errors to be WAIVED at P8 (0.35 mm die bar gap vs the 0.8 mm aiee_hv_143v_SW IPC-2221 rule)
decisions.why: Die geometry on a manufacturer-qualified 200 V part; IPC-2221 creepage governs board conductors, not a qualified component's internal terminals. No alternative part exists. U101's 4 solder_mask_bridge errors are NOT waived - those are a pulled-footprint artefact and get fixed

decisions.what: All constraints.json rects translated to ABSOLUTE coords (outline origin 6.635,39.335). New B.Cu-only GND bridge board-local [49,30,94,48]; zone A extended 48->51; zone C In2/B.Cu at x=92, In1 held to x=96
decisions.why: planes_gen/placelib consume rects verbatim as absolute. Board-local rects meant zone A poured only y 0-41 (no plane under the buck) and zone C landed on top of L301. B.Cu bridge chosen over In2: 1oz vs 0.5oz, and 1.554mm below F.Cu so a TANK_A crossing couples ~4.7pF not ~29pF

decisions.what: Spiral keepout radius NOT shrunk (stays r=20.55). Spirals nudged in y only; corridor 5.01 -> 6.02 mm, centre separation 46.84 mm
decisions.why: Widening 6->10 mm buys only 33 mW and 1.4 nH (0.5% of the 274 nH tank) against an un-analysed magnetics change to the Q 388/325 spirals. Nudge improves SPIRAL-5 margin and mutual coupling simultaneously

decisions.what: DERATE to 36 V bus / ~162 W (from 40 V / 200 W)
decisions.why: H4 owner ruling. theta_BS was assumed 1.5 C/W but is realistically 4.05-7.3 C/W (1.065 mm core, 18 vias), putting Tj 151-188 C nominal vs a 150 C abs max. Derate buys ~14 C; the four board fixes buy ~20 C more. Bus voltage is a bench knob, raisable once real Tj is measured

decisions.what: Revert gate resistors 6R8 -> 4R7
decisions.why: Common-source inductance measured 0.157 nH, ~5x smaller than the estimate 6R8 was bought against. Recovers ~4 C of Tj at no real ring cost (-0.85 V vs a -4 V floor)

decisions.what: All 8 verify/drc waiver classes APPROVED by owner at H4
decisions.why: Creepage set audited independently: all 21 verified inside the two die pad bboxes, /SW pour min distance to GND 0.8004 mm - nothing hiding. check_thermal confirmed heatsink-blind in source

decisions.what: OWNER REPRIORITISATION 2026-08-08: bench target is 25-30 V bus / 100-150 W with big fans. Thermals and max power DEPRIORITISED. Priorities are now (1) ZVS, (2) noisy-loop reduction, (3) does it work at all
decisions.why: Owner ruling. At 30 V, Vds pk ~107 V on a 200 V part and dissipation falls ~Vdd^2, so the theta_BS blocker stops binding. ZVS is LINEAR in Vdd, so the tank/shunt/match values stay valid unchanged at the lower bus - the derate costs nothing in correctness

decisions.what: SUPERSEDES the H4 fix list: drop the heatsink clamping holes, extra thermal vias and full 162 W re-derivation. Keep the B.Cu mask land + fiducials (cheap fab hygiene). Add: RUN the SPICE benches, which have never executed
decisions.why: Owner deprioritised thermals. SIM-1 (ZVS) and SIM-4 (tank/match) are the arbiters of whether the board functions, and verify_all has no sim_run member so the gate passed with them unexecuted

decisions.what: P8 FIX a3 - ZVS POPULATE: C308/C309 DNP, C320 populated 27pF (C_s 504 -> 419 pF), C203 DNP (C_shunt bank 83 -> 27 pF). Applied in kicad/gen/tank.py + stage.py; parts.json quantities follow (56pF line 18 -> 15 populated of 21, 27pF line 2 -> 3 of 6). No new part, no new land, no netlist change.
decisions.why: The P8 SPICE benches (first execution of this board's declared sims) proved the board missed ZVS as built: ~30 nH of un-imaged zone-B copper in series with the C_s bank pushed X_net/R from 1.283 to 2.00, Vds at turn-on 15.6 V and P_out 53 W of 113 W. Extra series L is cancelled by LESS series C. Measured after: X_net/R 1.285, Vds 1.36-1.41 V, dVds/dt -1.21 V/ns, P_out 113.8 W, Vds,pk 122.3 V; holds across the whole 25-35 nH stray band.

decisions.what: verify-waivers.json written at reports/verify-waivers.json, 8 entries, all approved 'Ihsan S. 2026-08-08 (checkpoint H4)'. gate verify PASS 0 failing / 31 waived.
decisions.why: Owner approved all 8 waiver classes at H4 (state.json human.4). Entries carry the reasons from reports/verify-waivers.md verbatim in substance. NB gate.py's default sidecar path is <pcb-dir>/reports/ (kicad/reports/), so the gate MUST be run with an explicit --waivers or the sidecar is silently ignored.

decisions.what: OPEN: vds_pk_40v_v = 172.5 V against the 155 V derate line is the ONE remaining sim error and was NOT waived or weakened. One populate cannot serve both 30 V and 40 V.
decisions.why: A populate trimmed at 30 V is under-shunted at 40 V because the charge-equivalent Coss falls as the swing grows. At the declared 25-30 V bench the peak is 98.2-122.2 V and at the H4 36 V ruling it is 152.1 V, both inside. Owner ruling needed: declare the bus ceiling at 36 V (bench setting, zero board change) or re-populate C203 at 56 pF and re-run bus_derating before ever running 40 V.
